validators.name: character-card
validators.behavior: Recognize leading Module A frontmatter or its seven body sections, then validate required string fields and ordered sections.
validators.recognitionAndBoundary: Ordinary prose/horizontal-rule reports are not misclassified; malformed recognized cards still receive diagnostics.
assertions: Matching valid content has no errors; malformed matching content reports the relevant error.
Warnings remain separate from errors and ordinary turn validation is advisory.
Automatic turn validation and artifact validation use the shared applicability registry.

validators.name: scenario-card
validators.behavior: Recognize Module B frontmatter and validate tags, a single-line world state, three to five beats and beat fields.
validators.recognitionAndBoundary: Beat label/variant_config/pivot_condition are nonempty; tension_target is integer0..100; duplicate/unknown fields and malformed beat structure are diagnosed.
assertions: Matching valid content has no errors; malformed matching content reports the relevant error.
Warnings remain separate from errors and ordinary turn validation is advisory.
Automatic turn validation and artifact validation use the shared applicability registry.

validators.name: runtime-packet
validators.behavior: Recognize Neural Chain/Beat packet markers and validate the existing Runtime packet contract.
validators.recognitionAndBoundary: Do not apply packet validation to unrecognized ordinary prose; preserve advisory findings and hidden-chain/HUD checks.
assertions: Matching valid content has no errors; malformed matching content reports the relevant error.
Warnings remain separate from errors and ordinary turn validation is advisory.
Automatic turn validation and artifact validation use the shared applicability registry.

validators.name: evaluate-report
validators.behavior: Recognize Neuro-Integrity Report or Overall Verdict and validate the Evaluate report contract.
validators.recognitionAndBoundary: A short summary pointing to a report file does not become an invalid inline report merely because the Engine declares this validator.
assertions: Matching valid content has no errors; malformed matching content reports the relevant error.
Warnings remain separate from errors and ordinary turn validation is advisory.
Automatic turn validation and artifact validation use the shared applicability registry.
